invariants.rationale: The method uses profile extensively without null checks, implying it is expected to be non-null.
The context parameter is passed and method calls are made on it, so it should not be null.
The method iterates over profile.getPartitionPaths(), so it is expected to be non-null.
The code works for any partition count; this checks partitionPaths is either empty or non-empty (partition count is non-negative).
If profile is set up to use output workload stats, the output partition path stat map should be non-null.
